name: find_next_line_break

name: run_pager_key_loop
description: Chooses how many lines to show from state flags, draws them in a loop, and reads a key after each pass. It stops when the quit key is pressed.

name: search_file_for_pattern

name: run_action_between_setup_calls

name: call_action_with_optional_follow

name: draw_then_decrement_line_count

name: draw_text_lines_until_limit

name: call_pair_with_state_field

name: copy_available_bytes_from_buffer

name: refill_read_buffer

name: scroll_window_to_position

name: read_line_into_buffer

description: Parses the DRIVE, NAME, FFS, NOICONS and QUICK options, checks that the drive exists, and prompts for a disk before initializing it. It prints the usage line when arguments are missing.

name: free_format_buffers
description: Frees the buffers the format command allocated, passing each stored pointer with its size to the free routine, and releases the supplied parameter last.

name: report_disk_io_error
description: Retries a disk operation while it reports a recoverable condition, then maps the error code to a message such as bad sector, seek error, disk changed or cannot open device. It prints the message and returns the code.

name: report_format_drive_status
description: Runs the drive preparation calls, then prints the matching message for a write-protected disk, no disk in the drive, or a format error. It returns the drive status code.

name: store_matching_drive_code
description: Looks up the given code in an eight-entry table and stores the matching value in a field of a record returned by a routine. It returns the code passed in.

name: find_drive_by_name
description: Walks the list of device nodes looking for a volume whose name matches the given drive text. It returns one when a match is found and zero when the list ends.

name: calculate_string_length
description: Returns the length of a null-terminated string by counting bytes up to the terminator.

name: copy_null_terminated_string
description: Copies bytes from a source string into a destination buffer, including the terminating zero byte.

name: convert_char_to_uppercase
description: Converts one lowercase ASCII letter to uppercase and returns other characters unchanged.

name: compare_strings_ignoring_case
description: Compares two null-terminated strings one byte at a time after converting each byte to uppercase. It returns one when they are equal and zero otherwise.

name: truncate_at_colon
description: Cuts a string at its first colon by writing a zero byte there, or at its end when no colon is present.

name: check_status_with_error_code
description: Passes its first argument in a one-element array to a routine with a fixed code, then returns an error code of one hundred twenty-six when that call fails and zero otherwise.

name: allocate_linked_record_from_template
description: Allocates a record, links its list fields to itself and to a template, and copies up to seven values from the source block into it. It returns the record, or zero when a step fails.

name: add_port_stub
description: Calls the AddPort entry of a stored exec library base and returns, registering a message port.

name: allocate_memory_stub
description: Calls the AllocMem entry of the stored exec library base and returns its result.

name: allocate_signal_stub
description: Calls the AllocSignal entry of the stored exec library base and returns the signal number it allocates.

name: close_device_stub
description: Calls the CloseDevice entry of the stored exec library base and returns.

name: close_library_stub
description: Calls the CloseLibrary entry of the stored exec library base and returns.

name: call_exec_entry_stub
description: Calls one exec library entry through the stored base and returns, with no processing of its own.

name: find_current_task_stub
description: Calls the FindTask entry of the stored exec library base and returns the task pointer it finds.

name: free_memory_stub
description: Calls the FreeMem entry of the stored exec library base and returns.

name: free_signal_stub
description: Calls the FreeSignal entry of the stored exec library base and returns, releasing a signal bit.

name: get_message_stub
description: Calls the GetMsg entry of the stored exec library base and returns the next message waiting on a port.

name: open_device_stub
description: Calls the OpenDevice entry of the stored exec library base and returns its result.

name: open_library_stub
description: Calls the OpenLibrary entry of the stored exec library base and returns its result.

name: put_message_stub
description: Calls the PutMsg entry of the stored exec library base and returns, sending a message to a port.

name: remove_port_stub
description: Calls the RemPort entry of the stored exec library base and returns, unregistering a message port.

name: set_signal_stub
description: Calls the SetSignal entry of the stored exec library base and returns the previous signal state.

name: wait_port_stub
description: Calls the WaitPort entry of the stored exec library base and returns, blocking until a message arrives on the port.

name: forward_argument_to_library_call
description: Passes its single argument to a library routine together with a stored base pointer and the address of a stack slot, then returns.

name: free_trap_stub
description: Calls the FreeTrap entry of a stored exec library base and returns.

name: format_disk_cylinder_by_cylinder
description: Runs the format loop cylinder by cylinder through the disk port, reporting progress with the cylinder count to go. It initializes and verifies the disk, then releases its interrupt server and buffers.

name: configure_disk_port_timing
description: Sets timing values on the disk port using two fixed values and an enable value, then passes the parameter through the port routine.

name: format_and_output_text
description: Formats text into a 140-byte stack buffer with the system formatter, measures the resulting string, and passes any non-empty text with its length to a write routine.

name: store_output_byte
description: Stores the low byte of its input register at the address held in the pointer register and returns. It acts as the per-character output hook for the formatter.

name: unsigned_divide_with_remainder
description: Performs an unsigned 32-bit division by shift and subtract when the divisor is large, or a 16-bit modulo when it fits in 16 bits. It returns the remainder and quotient as a pair.

name: restoring_division_core
description: Runs the restoring-division inner loop for sixteen steps on the dividend and divisor registers, leaving the quotient and remainder in place.
